check: Verify discover_chat_template_in_dir and its callers: an explicit template override wins; local discovery tries chat_template.jinja, then the string chat_template in tokenizer_config.json, then legacy chat_template.json, then other .jinja files. Reconcile precedence wherever the assigned page describes it.

Trace PolicyOnly through ApprovalOutcome::Decided to ToolDenied(entry.tool_name()). The configured deny_with_reason text is not the caller-visible error on this path. Distinguish audit-log reason from the returned tool-name error; do not infer behavior from the unreachable Pending policy-denial branch.

The Template Variables section must retain released strftime_now(format) behavior and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH reproducibility guidance. Verify render_instant, strftime and render context injection: one instant per render, local time, cached epoch override and invalid-format errors. Main contains this released material while the prepared snapshot omitted it.

An all-overloaded pool steers to the least-loaded routable worker by default. The 503 overload shed requires --worker-overload-shed, which defaults false. Verify both selection and dispatch gates. Qualify every summary of overload shedding, including Why Limit Admission, consistently with the overload concept page.

A no_available_workers 503 is marked non-retryable for the router retry loop and carries Retry-After: 1 for clients. Check the Waiting-Queue Cap paragraph as well as retries: do not promise an internal retry after backoff when every worker is at the cap.

Document the released Rust vLLM launcher KV publisher default, not only the SGLang/TokenSpeed variants: absent --kv-events-config enables the publisher, SMG_VLLM_SERVICER_KV_EVENTS=0 keeps it off, and explicit configuration is preserved. Trace default_kv_events_config through RustLauncher before engine creation.

Compare the complete Branch enum/as_str and emission call with the policy metric table. There are six values, including implicit_key_hit for x-forwarded-for/cookie without an explicit routing key. random_fallback requires neither explicit nor implicit key. Reconcile the metrics reference and sticky-session concept page.

Verify the selected ZMQ path disables shm_enabled before serialization. ZMQ workers receive inline tensors; an adapter capable of reading SHM does not prove the gateway sends it. Reconcile configuration and multimodal transport descriptions.

Validate successful WASM registration examples against blocked path prefixes. /etc is rejected; success examples must use an allowed absolute path. Keep path and module name consistent in subsequent requests.

Verify --stream-body-stall-timeout-secs applies to buffered as well as streamed request bodies through middleware. The flag name alone does not imply streaming-only scope. Distinguish 408 request_body_stalled for the stall watchdog from request_body_timeout for a buffered read incomplete at request-timeout-secs; include both released error codes and keep API tables consistent with configuration.

Trace PD timing separately through regular chat, generate, completions, Messages and Harmony streams. Only regular gRPC chat/generate paths carry PdTiming and emit the PD TTFT pair from prefill/decode dispatch; completions, Messages and Harmony paths discard it. Generic router TTFT on paths without PdTiming uses their streaming-task start when recorded. Qualify both metric table rows and related-series prose; do not generalize the prefill anchor to every gRPC endpoint or parser path. Verify the distinct HTTP PD response-head contract and reconcile the concept page with the metrics reference.

Trace worker removal through Metrics::remove_worker_metrics and WorkerSeries::retire: removed-worker series are dropped from scrapes, not retained with smg_worker_health=-1. Distinguish a registered worker's health or engine-gauge sentinels from removal. Reconcile the monitoring guide and metrics reference.

Trace maybe_rate_limiter and default_max_concurrent_requests: the default negative max-concurrent-requests value enables admission with a host-derived cap; a positive value supplies an explicit cap and zero disables it. Do not claim admission metrics require explicitly supplying --max-concurrent-requests. Describe metric emission conditions from their actual recording paths.

Trace smg_pd_prefill_admission_wait_seconds through start_prometheus and the complete histogram_bucket_overrides list. No bucket matcher applies to this name, so it exports as a Prometheus summary with the default quantiles, not a bucketed histogram. The Rust histogram recording macro does not determine the Prometheus export type. Reconcile the PD concept table and metrics reference.

Inspect every active caller of record_pd_kv_transfer_failure. smg_pd_kv_transfer_failures_total includes missing NIXL transfer parameters with decode recomputation and HTTP MoRI-IO pair validation or missing/invalid handoff failures that reject the request. Cover sequential and concurrent MoRI-IO paths; do not describe the counter as only NIXL or claim all increments mean successful recomputation. Reconcile concept and reference descriptions.

Verify the SGLang launch integration and runnable examples at this release: the supported command uses --grpc-mode. Do not copy later --smg-grpc-mode, --smg-http-sidecar-port, HTTP-sidecar defaults, or a deprecation claim for --grpc-mode from main unless supported by this pinned release. Keep launch commands and accompanying option tables consistent across the getting-started guides.

Trace smg_mcp_tool_iterations_total across both model_gateway and external_router, including the default providers feature chain. Released Anthropic Messages MCP loops record this counter in streaming and non-streaming paths when MCP toolsets are enabled, alongside Responses API loops. Preserve this shipped provider coverage; do not narrow the metric to Responses by examining only one crate or recorder.

Trace aliased tool exposure and execution through McpToolSession, approval params and PolicyEngine. Alias entries replace the direct tool and use the qualified identity alias:<alias name>; original server/tool policy keys and original-server trust do not match that identity. Explain how to configure policy for the exposed alias and qualify blanket original-server denial claims. Verify precedence, alias annotations and active callers; describe the current operator-facing contract without a bug narrative.

Verify the actual JSON error.type emitted by shed_response through create_error/error_type_for_status: gateway 503 examples use server_error, not the HTTP reason phrase Service Unavailable. Reconcile the rate-limiting example, overload guide and OpenAI error table.

Trace StreamFailure::error_type and the send_error_sse caller. Worker-failed streams emit stream_error, request-fault statuses use the corresponding HTTP error-body type, and internal_error is reserved for gateway processing failures. Do not label all post-first-chunk gRPC errors internal_error; keep the example and its explanation aligned.

Follow real JSON extractor rejection, Messages envelope conversion and response headers. ValidatedJson inserts RejectionCode for metrics but no X-SMG-Error-Code header; Messages conversion preserves existing headers rather than creating that header from a body error code. Do not generalize a bad_request(json_parse_error) test fixture to the active extractor path. Reconcile both API references and distinguish gateway-builder error-code headers from validation failures.

Trace over_count_pressure_gate and absolute_margin. Both relative and absolute comparisons must pass, but the absolute margin is min(balance_abs_threshold, max(ceil(2 * sqrt(mean)), 4)), not the configured threshold alone. Keep overview summaries consistent with the canonical Cache-Aware Routing page. Prefer a concise adaptive-margin summary with a link to its Spill Gate section instead of duplicating formulas; never describe --balance-abs-threshold as the actual fixed margin.

Trace the actual installation of cache_trace::scope and response-header emission. At this release only the gRPC pipeline, shared by gRPC and ZMQ workers, installs the capture scope. HTTP-worker routers do not; shared policy recorder calls are inert without it. Qualify the Decision Traces section, SMG_CACHE_TRACE switches and x-smg-cache-trace request/response header behavior to the supported worker transports.

Trace RequestSpan::make_span and attach_edge_layers. http_request records request.uri().path(), never the full URI/query string, and the fallback is installed before edge layers so every request to the main listener is covered, including unmatched routes. Keep monitoring and logging summaries consistent; the separate health-check listener does not cross those middleware layers.

Verify the complete labels emitted by record_mcp_tool_call for smg_mcp_tool_calls_total: model, tool_name and result. Include model in the monitoring guide summary as well as the metric reference; do not infer label completeness from an old summary table.

Trace startup through RouterConfig::validate and validate_server_settings: the global --load-monitor-interval must be greater than zero; zero is rejected before serving. Do not replace that requirement with a one-second clamp based on lower-level polling or Retry-After helpers. Distinguish a worker spec load_monitor_interval_secs override, whose group polling interval is floored to one second, from the validated global CLI setting. Keep overload, configuration and Admin API descriptions consistent.

Trace early returns before every record_worker_cache_aware_policy_branch call. --cache-index hash dispatch and KV-pressure fallback return before the branch counter; smg_cache_aware_policy_branch_total covers tree/event-driven selections, not every routing decision. Qualify the quick-start summary consistently with the canonical policy and metric descriptions.

Verify released selection_queue_timeout (503, Retry-After: 2 from middleware::SHED_RETRY_AFTER_SECS) and pd_prefill_queue_full / pd_prefill_queue_timeout (429, no Retry-After). Include all three in both the OpenAI Error Codes and Rate Limiting tables. Distinguish the gRPC remaining gateway queue-time budget from the PD-specific queue timeout, and do not use the unrelated overload module default of 10 seconds for selection_queue_timeout.

Verify smg.ai/kv-connector through discovery and actual PD dispatch. The discovery warning claims passthrough for unlisted connectors, but MoRIIOConnector selects KvConnectorMode::MoriIo at dispatch. moriio_endpoint requires read/write moriio_mode labels unavailable from the supported pod annotations; missing labels cause 503 moriio_pair_misconfigured. Carve this released connector out of any other value is passthrough claims and direct MoRI-IO workers to registration with the required labels, linking the canonical PD section. Do not treat the discovery warning as proof of request behavior.

Trace discovery auto-recovery through AddWorker and the local worker_registration workflow. HTTP/gRPC connection detection requires a successful health probe before worker creation/activation and retries at startup cadence; a still-down engine waits for registration rather than being repeatedly registered Ready and demoted by background probes. Keep the health-checks Worker Auto-Recovery table consistent with service discovery. Distinguish ZMQ explicit ipc reachability and activation semantics rather than generalizing HTTP/gRPC probes to it.

The released checkout contains rust-toolchain.toml pinning Rust 1.98.0 with clippy/rustfmt. Align Quick Start and Development: let rustup honor that checked-in pin instead of instructing a persistent rustup override set 1.98.0, which can shadow later pin changes. Nightly rustfmt remains a separate explicit nightly toolchain. Keep actionable prerequisite versions without claiming the repository lacks its toolchain file.

Trace ProviderProfile::Minimax through resolve_user_thinking. MiniMax does not turn thinking off for reasoning_effort none/minimal, and an explicit effort outranks thinking.type disabled. Do not describe DeepSeek-V4 as the only exception to a universal none/minimal disables-thinking rule. Reconcile the pipeline summary with the OpenAI API contract without dropping other model-specific renderer rules.

Trace execute_without_mcp and MCP model turns through execute_chat_for_responses and the shared chat preparation/building stages. Eligible Responses requests can use Symphony when configured; do not claim that every endpoint except Chat Completions and Messages always uses legacy parsers. Verify each streaming/Harmony path separately before extending that statement.

Verify zmq_vllm_mm: an extra multimodal proto batch is rejected because vLLM ZMQ accepts one modality per request. Mixed image/video requests require the gRPC backend. Keep the Video summary, Direct ZMQ Backends paragraph and ZMQ capability table consistent; do not generalize vLLM gRPC mixed-modality support to direct ZMQ.

Verify implicit_key in the active policy selection: X-Forwarded-For, then Cookie may supply an implicit routing key; Authorization is excluded. Reconcile the configuration policy-summary row as well as detailed routing-header descriptions. Preserve explicit target-worker/routing-key priorities and do not present credentials as session affinity.

Trace the startup worker-count validator including its IGW early return and !has_service_discovery && !config.dp_aware guard. The power_of_two two-worker checks for regular and PD prefill/decode pools are skipped with service discovery, --dp-aware or --enable-igw. Include all exceptions in any summary that states this startup requirement, especially the PD Per-Phase Policies table.

Verify the supported direct ZMQ backend enumeration: vLLM, TokenSpeed and SGLang. Keep introductory and Next Steps summaries consistent with the detailed ZMQ capability table; do not describe support as vLLM/TokenSpeed only. Distinguish ZMQ exclusion from PD/EPD from a blanket claim that PD never supports HTTP workers.
